summary: The off-peak window (orphan prune, counter reconcile, vacuum, hourly snapshot) had one caller, the collection loop, which an offline instance never starts: auto_cleanup and auto_incremental_vacuum read null with 7.9 M orphan keyword rows. A 5-minute timer (the loop's own cadence) now runs the same window while the loop is stopped and yields, with a recorded reason, to the loop, an exclusive window, a re-index drain or a writer job. OO_OFFLINE_MAINTENANCE=0 declines it.
